summary: Dell Technologies subsidiaries Dell International L.L.C. and EMC Corporation completed a $5.0 billion four-tranche senior unsecured note offering under an existing Form S-3ASR shelf: $1.25B 5.100% notes due 2029, $1.25B 5.400% notes due 2031, $1.50B 5.600% notes due 2033 and $1.00B 5.900% notes due 2037. The notes are guaranteed jointly and severally by Dell Technologies, Denali Intermediate and Dell Inc., ranking pari passu with senior indebtedness. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date is stated. This is ordinary capital markets financing, not a special situation; watch leverage, coupon curve and buyback funding.
